questions.question: An online data transfer service that automates and accelerates moving large amounts of data between on-premises storage systems and AWS storage services using a software agent.
A managed database migration service that helps you migrate databases to AWS quickly and securely with minimal downtime. The source database remains operational during the migration.
A family of physical devices used to collect, process, and transfer large amounts of data offline to AWS when network bandwidth is insufficient, ranging from terabytes to exabytes of capacity.
A service that provides a single location to track the progress of application migrations across multiple AWS and partner migration tools, giving visibility into the status of each migration.
A service that incrementally replicates your on-premises VMware vSphere and Microsoft Hyper-V VMs to AWS, enabling you to migrate virtual machines to AWS with minimal downtime.

An application migration service that simplifies and expedites migration of applications to AWS by automatically converting source servers to run natively on AWS, supporting both rehost and replatform strategies.
